WORLD WIDE NEWS COVERAGE.
X M H C
THE VOICE OF THE SHANGHAI EVENING POST & MERCURY
17 AVENUE EDWARD VII . . . TEL 84089 . . . SHANGHAI, CHINA
700 KILOCYCLES 428.5 METERS
July 11, 1938.

Deputy Commissioner S.C. Young,
S. M. Police,
195 Foochow Road,
Shanghai.

Dear Mr. Young,

We have just completed a letter to Mr.
Dubb, Deputy Secretary of the Council, offering
the medium of our radio broadcasts, (Mandarin,
Cantonese, English) as one more method whereby the
Council could communicate official notices to the
public whenever and as often as might be deemed
necessary. Actually, we feel we reach more people
within the settlement than the total of all news-
papers combined, but that is a moot point. What
we wanted to do, was to make certain that the
Settlement police know where we stand on this
matter, i.e., that we are always willing to do any-
thing in our power to assist police work with the
broadcast of official notices. Therefore, this
letter to you.

May we express our appreciation to you
for your attention and courtesy in this matter,
before we sign ourselves.

Yours very truly,
RADIO STATION XMHC
R. Y. Phillips.

全球新闻报道。
X M H C
《上海晚邮报与水星报》之声
中国上海，爱德华七世路17号 . . . 电话 84089 . . .
700千周 428.5米
1938年7月11日。

致：
S.C. 杨 副警务总监，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海福州路195号。

亲爱的杨先生：

我们刚刚完成了一封致工部局副总办 Dubb 先生的信函，提出利用我们的无线电广播（普通话、粤语、英语）作为另一种渠道，以便工部局在认为必要时，随时并多次向公众发布官方通告。实际上，我们认为我们在租界内触及的受众比所有报纸的总和还要多，但这尚存争议。我们想要做的，是确保租界警方了解我们在此事上的立场，即我们始终愿意竭尽所能，通过广播官方通告来协助警务工作。因此，特致此信给您。

在署名之前，谨对您在此事上的关注与礼遇表示谢意。

您真诚的，
XMHC 广播电台
R. Y. 菲利普斯。

RCP:AM
